description: Northern Provincial Council - Northern Province provincial Council has adopted the Mineral Tax statute of the Northern P/C No. 03 of 2017 on 25th May 2017
reasoning: This gazette content enacts a new provincial statute (Mineral Tax Statute, No. 03 of 2017) that establishes a legal framework for imposing and collecting a mineral tax. It contains detailed regulatory provisions including tax rates, compliance requirements, filing procedures, penalties for default, and ministerial powers for exemptions. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it creates new legislation and regulatory requirements rather than dealing with government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
